relay.weightSelection: maximize exact one-to-one match accuracy on STUDY-00, STUDY-10, and STUDY-20 only
relay.finalEvaluation: apply frozen weights once to STUDY-30
relay.nullModel: 10000 independent within-batch label permutations on STUDY-30
relay.chanceGate: protected held-out accuracy must not exceed the preregistered 95th percentile of the within-batch null
negativeControls: protected trace with stable package token restored

resolver.sharedPrototypeStore: same-host filesystem with atomic exclusive claim creation
resolver.normalGate: exactly one opened-one response, 99 replay responses, one claim, one receipt, and one outcome
resolver.crashGate: a crash after claim produces no outcome; recovery appends one receipt before releasing one outcome
resolver.receiptProof: RFC 9162-style domain-separated Merkle inclusion proof over the receipt ledger

interpretationBoundary: The seal fixes a synthetic same-repository experiment. Git chronology can establish ordering after this file is pushed, but it is not an independent institutional preregistration or trusted timestamp.
